description: Search a whole area, square by square, and collect up to maxPlaces of the places in it. Answers straight away with the collection, then works through the area in the background. Read the collection again to see how far it has got. Starting one costs nothing: each new place costs one credit as it arrives, and saved places cost nothing. Needs an API key.

enrich.description: Add ["emails"] to also look for email addresses. Costs one more credit for each place that has one, and needs a paid plan.

geo.description: Where to search. Give exactly one of: a Brazilian city as location, a lat/lng point with radiusM, a bbox, or a cityIbge with radiusKm.

keywords.description: What to search for, such as ["bakery", "coffee shop"]. One search per term.

lang.description: The language to search in. New places come back in it. Two letters, such as pt or en.

maxPlaces.description: Stop after this many places. Defaults to the most your plan collects at once.

minRating.description: Keep only places rated at least this, from 1 to 5. Null keeps every place.

name: create_collection
title: Start a collection
